tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_positive_fixint
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack reader optimization on a contiguous array of positive fixints.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_negative_fixint
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack reader optimization on a contiguous array of negative fixints.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_uint_types
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack reader optimization on unsigned integer types (uint8, uint16, uint32, uint64) inside a contiguous array.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_int_types
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack reader optimization on signed integer types (int8, int16, int32, int64) inside a contiguous array.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_floats_and_bools
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack reader optimization on float32, float64, boolean, and nil values inside a contiguous array.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_non_contiguous
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack reader behavior with non-contiguous input (std::list) where bulk scan capability is disabled.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_mixed_array_stop
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack scalar run stopping cleanly when encountering a non-scalar element (e.g., string) inside the array.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_array16_and_array32
tests.intent: Probe enter_msgpack_array with array16 (0xDC) and array32 (0xDD) headers.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_empty_array
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack scalar run with an empty array where length is zero.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_buffer_edge_short
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack scalar run termination when buffer remaining bytes are fewer than required by the head size.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_nested_arrays
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack reader optimization on nested arrays containing scalar runs.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_sax_parsing_event_log
tests.intent: Probe SAX event callbacks when parsing a MessagePack scalar run via custom sax handler.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_sax_rejection
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack scalar run aborting immediately when the SAX handler returns false.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_span_input_adapter
tests.intent: Probe parsing using span_input_adapter directly with from_msgpack.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_unhandled_head_byte
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack scalar run handling an unexpected head byte (e.g., map marker 0x80) gracefully.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_trailing_data
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack parsing when extra unconsumed bytes follow a scalar array run.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_consecutive_arrays
tests.intent: Probe multiple consecutive arrays processed by scalar runs in a stream.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_boundary_values
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack scalar run with boundary numeric limits (e.g., maximum uint64 and minimum int64).

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_mixed_scalar_and_map
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack array starting with scalar run elements followed by a map element.

tests.name: msgpack_scalar_run_invalid_prefix
tests.intent: Probe MessagePack error handling when an array header opens but input contains invalid bytes immediately.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise parse_msgpack_scalar_run with JSON_HEDLEY_NEVER_INLINE attribute and ensure non-inlined code execution.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise positive fixints in the default switch branch inside parse_msgpack_scalar_run where head <= 0x7F.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise negative fixints in the default switch branch inside parse_msgpack_scalar_run where head >= 0xE0.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise the fallback branch in parse_msgpack_scalar_run switch default where a non-scalar/non-fixint head causes the scalar run to terminate and return true.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercise early return false in parse_msgpack_scalar_run when the SAX handler returns false during scalar run processing.

tests.intent: Probe MessagePack scalar run aborting immediately when the SAX handler returns false.
